task.title: Revert private planning for empty scene openers
task.source: Post-deployment user report that the added planning path made Roleplay writing quality worse
task.classification: engine generation, prompt assembly, and model-produced user-visible prose

coreClaim: New empty-transcript /scene openers no longer receive the extra PR #1210 private-planner instruction or its forced terminal-user fallback, restoring the exact pre-PR runtime behavior.
rootCause: PR #1210 changed the writer's steering by forcing an ephemeral scene-opening instruction through the private Agent beat planner. The deployed result was reported to overconstrain the visible writer and reduce prose quality, so the safest response is to remove that newly introduced behavior rather than layer on another speculative prompt adjustment.

inScope: Removal of the PR #1210 regressions that required the unwanted planner behavior
Removal of the superseded PR #1210 proof ledger
outOfScope: Changing the configured Agent model or visible writer model
Claiming deterministic measurement of subjective prose quality

claimBoundary.coreClaim: The PR #1210 runtime changes are absent and the generation engine matches its immediate pre-PR parent.
claimBoundary.riskType: prompt role ordering and model-call routing
entrypoints: Generated /scene opening with an empty transcript
outOfScopeClaims: No claim that every future prose sample will satisfy a subjective quality threshold.
No claim that the underlying empty-input provider rejection is repaired after the rollback.
No claim that Conversation or Game behavior changes.

contractLaneGate.brokenContract: The newly deployed empty-scene planning behavior worsened the prose experience it was intended to improve.
contractLaneGate.producer: src/engine/generation/start-generation.ts supplied ephemeral opening intent to the private planner.
contractLaneGate.consumer: src/engine/generation/agent-runner.ts converted that intent into an additional private beat-plan request before the visible writer call.
contractLaneGate.impliedContract: Private quality guidance must not make the user's visible Roleplay prose worse.
contractLaneGate.actualEnforcement: The newly added instruction path is removed exactly; the runtime generation files match commit 825bf82c7e4bad07e89f7f1b48ac38073c87d1c0.
contractLaneGate.primaryOwnerDetail: The TypeScript generation engine owns request assembly and Agent-to-writer guidance.
contractLaneGate.wrongLaneFixToAvoid: Do not compensate with UI special cases, provider fallbacks, or another unvalidated prompt layer.
regressionProof: git diff --exit-code against PR #1210's parent proves the runtime and test tree is identical to the pre-PR state before adding this ledger.
The focused generation and /scene suite passes after the rollback.

positiveRows.claim: The unwanted ephemeral Roleplay craft instruction is gone.
positiveRows.evidence: The exact inverse removes roleplayCraftInstruction from GenerationAgentRuntimeInput and all three start-generation call sites.

positiveRows.claim: The forced terminal-user planner fallback is gone.
positiveRows.evidence: The exact inverse removes both the injected opening intent and the generic fallback user message from runRoleplayCraftBeatPlan.

contradictionRows.claim: The rollback must not replace Nano/GLM 5.2 or change connection selection.
contradictionRows.evidence: No connection, provider, or model-selection files change.

contradictionRows.claim: The rollback must not alter Conversation or Game behavior.
contradictionRows.evidence: Only Roleplay generation engine files and proof artifacts change.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Existing Narrative Craft behavior outside PR #1210 remains intact.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: The branch matches PR #1210's immediate parent for runtime code, and the existing Narrative Craft focused tests pass.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Existing saved-message Roleplay planning remains covered.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: The retained agent-runner and Narrative Craft background test suites pass.

untestedRows: A new provider-generated prose sample is not asserted as objective proof because prose quality is stochastic and the user already supplied the decisive live quality report.

ownedFacts.evidence: git fetch origin main and git rev-parse origin/main returned 0cd0dd4752b09cffa448d0945608c4a489fa3057.

ownedFacts.description: The rollback runtime tree matches the immediate pre-PR parent.
ownedFacts.evidence: git diff --exit-code 825bf82c7e4bad07e89f7f1b48ac38073c87d1c0 returned exit code 0 before the new proof ledger was added.

ownedFacts.description: The deployed PR #1210 behavior reduced writing quality for the user's live Roleplay experience.
ownedFacts.evidence: The user explicitly requested the change be reverted because the current behavior makes writing quality poor.

manualBlockers.item: Subjective prose quality varies by model sample
manualBlockers.reason: The core rollback claim is deterministic; future prose quality remains a user-observed product judgment.

manualBlockers.reason: Unrelated UI tests repeatedly attempted to contact an unavailable remote runtime before the command timeout closed the reporter pipe. The 47 directly affected tests pass, pnpm check passes, and hosted deterministic validation remains required before merge.
